verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's docs claim layout-aware 'agentic OCR' that handles scans, images, complex layouts, handwriting and checkboxes (llamaparse-docs-2, llamaparse-docs-25, llamaparse-docs-12), and community testimony confirms it outperforms open-source parsers on complex documents (llamaparse-comm-1). However there is no explicit evidence addressing skewed-page correction or stamp handling specifically, and independent community feedback flags real accuracy gaps (mismatched benchmark numbers, tables not returned in clean tabular form) (llamaparse-comm-3, llamaparse-comm-6). Missing for 10: dedicated evidence on skew/rotation correction, stamp detection/handling, and independent benchmarking on low-quality/scanned photo inputs.
